channel.title: Blocktape
channel.description: Blocktape reports crypto news: exchange and market moves, protocol upgrades, token launches, security incidents, regulation and enforcement across chains.

item.title: Blast sets Oct. 26 interface deadline as integrators plan exits
item.description: Blast gave users until Oct. 26 to withdraw through its interface; integrators should map balances, pause new deposits and prepare users for contract withdrawals.

item.title: Fairshake backs 32 House candidates, pledges $6 million
item.description: Fairshake will back 32 House candidates who supported the stalled CLARITY Act, including six receiving $1 million each, as November midterms approach.

item.title: Solana Foundation Releases Atomic Settlement Tool for Institutions
item.description: Solana Foundation released an MIT-licensed escrow program on Oct. 6 for atomic settlement, with J.P. Morgan input and production partners still sought.

item.title: Fairshake backs 32 House candidates after crypto bill stalls
item.description: Fairshake named 32 House candidates for midterm support, including six set to receive $1 million each, as the Senate’s CLARITY Act stalled in September.

item.title: How chainslist helps add the right EVM network
item.description: Chainslist helps users add an EVM network by matching its chain ID and RPC endpoint to a wallet, then checking the selected chain before sending funds.

item.title: Fairshake names 32 House candidates for midterm support
item.description: Fairshake named 32 House candidates for midterm support on Oct. 5, including six set for $1 million each, as Senate crypto rules remain stalled ahead of November.

item.title: NEAR Intents recovers $3.8M after 48-hour ultimatum
item.description: NEAR Intents says it recovered the $3.8 million taken in a breach after identifying the exploiter and setting a 48-hour deadline for the return.

item.title: Ethereum Foundation puts private API payment system zkAPI on mainnet
item.description: Ethereum Foundation and Open Anonymity Project launched zkAPI Oct. 1 to separate API payments from identity; prompts and network metadata remain visible.

item.title: Polygon withdrawals trade lower cost for faster delivery
item.description: Polygon withdrawals trade settlement path against speed: the native bridge waits for its exit process, while liquidity routes charge for earlier delivery.

item.title: How to Read BNB Chain Token Volume
item.description: BNB Chain token volume tracks value traded over a chosen period, but pool depth, price movement and wallet activity determine what that figure can tell beginners.

item.title: Polygon PoS withdrawals to Ethereum take about three hours
item.description: Polygon PoS withdrawals to Ethereum commonly wait for a checkpoint, then need a separate claim; the route determines whether settlement takes hours or days.

item.title: Stage Funds Before a Vault Redemption
item.description: Check a crypto vault’s exit rules, estimate the assets due and prepare gas and destination funds before submitting a redemption request.

item.title: Five invariants for BNB Chain wallet indexers
item.description: BNB Chain wallet indexers need five checks for chain identity, event ordering, finality, token metadata and replay safety to keep balances and histories consistent.

item.title: How to send USDT on TRON with less TRX
item.description: USDT transfers on TRON consume Energy and Bandwidth; staking, delegated Energy or a wallet-sponsored transfer can reduce the TRX burned for each send.

item.title: What Out of Range Means for Concentrated Base Liquidity
item.description: On Base, concentrated liquidity puts tokens inside a chosen price band; learn what changes when the market moves outside it, including token mix, fee income and next steps.

item.title: Avalanche swap slippage: what beginners need to know
item.description: Slippage tolerance sets the minimum output an Avalanche swap will accept; beginners can use it to weigh failed trades against receiving fewer tokens.

item.title: Check Token Mix Before Removing Solana Liquidity
item.description: Check a Solana pool’s token mints, estimated withdrawal amounts and unclaimed fees before signing; concentrated positions can return an uneven token mix.

item.title: Ethereum Foundation launches zkAPI on mainnet
item.description: Ethereum Foundation and Open Anonymity put zkAPI on Ethereum mainnet on Oct. 1, using zero-knowledge proofs to separate AI billing from user identity.

item.title: Estimate slippage before a token swap
item.description: Estimate swap slippage by comparing the live route quote with the spot price, then account for pool depth, fees and price movement before setting a minimum output.

item.title: ICBA sues OCC over crypto firms’ national trust charters
item.description: The ICBA sued the OCC on Oct. 2, seeking to undo a rule and guidance it says let crypto firms pursue national trust charters without bank safeguards.
